What is a disadvantage of producing ethanol using the catalytic addition of steam to ethene?
A
the energy cost is low
B
the process is continuous
C
the process uses a non-renewable raw material
D
the ethanol is pure

options.label: C
options.text: the process uses a non-renewable raw material
